{{Quote|That's not the ''Falcon''.''"<br />"''WHAT?!''"<br />"''It's a fake. These guys actually dug up a working YT-1300 somewhere.|Leia Organa Solo, Wedge Antilles and Han Solo|<ref name="Heir to the Empire 2">[[Heir to the Empire 2|''Heir to the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''fake ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''''' was used by a [[Team Four (Noghri)|team]] of [[Noghri Death Commando]]s on [[Bpfassh]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] in an [[Mission to Bpfassh|attempt]] to capture [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her unborn twins for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]].

==History==
In their continuing efforts to kidnap her, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], had managed to find another working [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]], using it in an attempt to trick the Solos into coming aboard and into the hands of their would-be captors.

The deception was realized when Organa Solo noticed that the ''Millennium Falcon'' was not using its underside swivel [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and that she could not sense the presence of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] inside. In order to drive off the kidnappers, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used his wife's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to disable the ship by cutting the coolant lines to its main reactor. This simultaneously sent up a highly visible column of gas as a distress signal and disabled the Noghri assassins on board as they breathed in the [[korfaise]] gas that was released.
